verdict: Ensemble beats both singles — the KG embedding carries orthogonal signal worth keeping.

findings.title: KG-embedding complementarity vs gene overlap
findings.detail: On held-out treat edges: gene-overlap AUROC 0.689, KG-embedding 0.694, rank-average ensemble 0.735 (lift +0.042 over the best single). Ensemble beats both singles — the KG embedding carries orthogonal signal worth keeping.
findings.capa: Keep the KG embedding as an engine signal only if the ensemble lift is positive and reproducible; otherwise prefer the simpler mechanistic score.
